captions.detailed: An airfield-scale advertising blimp featuring a large, grey, cigar-shaped main gas envelope. Below the envelope hangs a blue and grey passenger gondola, flanked on either side by vectoring engine pylons supporting rotatable engine nacelles with black propellers. The tail section has a cruciform configuration featuring four fins with alternating blue and red control surfaces (rudders and elevators). The propellers rotate continuously, the rudders and elevators pivot on their hinges, and the engine pods rotate on their pylon pivots.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an advertising blimp with a large grey gas envelope, an underslung blue/grey gondola, and a cruciform tail with red and blue control surfaces. Ensure it has movable parts including rotating propellers, pivoting tail rudders/elevators, and vectoring engine pods mounted on lateral pylons.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp by first modeling the main gas envelope using a lofted or revolved profile. The gondola is constructed with box and cylinder primitives, colored blue and grey, and positioned underneath. The tail fins are extruded profiles placed at 90-degree intervals on the tail, with separate movable control surfaces attached via revolute joints. Lateral engine pylons are built using cylinders, terminating in rotatable engine pods with spinning multi-blade propellers connected via continuous joints.
